title: "M5-01 Reproducibility Inventory"
format: gfm

Status: current

## Question

Which numeric statements in the existing M0–M4 performance reports and contract evidence have a reproducible source, and which evidence gaps remain?

## Method

The committed extractor [claims.py](../../analysis/simciv_analysis/claims.py) reads the report/contract source tree and assigns provenance from [`sources.toml`](sources.toml). Its tidy output [claims.csv.gz](claims.csv.gz) contains **32,465** rows; the prior packed ledger [superseded/claims.csv](superseded/claims.csv) contains **37,612** expanded scalar values. M5-04 statuses are applied only to source-map entries assigned to that stage. Excluded inputs are table columns or labeled assignments for population/workload sizes, group and neighbor counts, seeds, replicates, horizons/days, thread/chunk settings, and simulation parameter values. Free-text numbers are only extracted from tables, report Summary/Findings/Status sections, selected audit/graduation tables, and measured contract sections. The machine-readable contracts/m1_contract.toml is a configuration/contract input and is not scanned as a measured report.

## Results

Every table below is generated from [claims.csv.gz](claims.csv.gz) by the report generator [report_m5_01.py](../../analysis/simciv_analysis/report_m5_01.py). Old-ledger matching is diagnostic only and does not populate source paths, statuses, or M5 stages.

The tidy ledger contains **783** headline claims, **895** key claims, and **30,787** supporting claims.

#### Match and unmapped reasons

| old record disposition                    | records | rule                                                                                      |
| ----------------------------------------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| old rows matched (informational)          | 1,988   | RENAMES.md plus normalized source/value; line breaks ties; does not assign new provenance |
| old rows unmatched                        | 35,624  | includes excluded inputs, changed/unselected text, and ambiguous old matches              |
| new rows ambiguous                        | 731     | current claims with conflicting metadata or tied candidates; these are new-row counts     |
| historical-log subset of transferred rows | 29      | M1 aggregate runs are not regeneration gaps                                               |
| previous exact-name/line/value baseline   | 653     | old rows matched before the correction; diagnostic baseline                               |
| old report basenames in RENAMES.md        | 29,669  | diagnostic count; this may overlap matched and unmatched rows                             |

The old ledger text-matches **3,695** new claims for comparison; **28,770** do not match. These matches do not transfer status or provenance. The extractor assigns harness, data, status, and M5 stage from [`sources.toml`](sources.toml) and the committed regeneration results.

### M1 unrecoverable-claim recheck

The **29** previously unrecoverable M1 aggregate claims were rechecked against current tests, goldens, and the M1 manifest. All remain `historical-log`: current tests and canonical artifacts revalidate behavior, not the original aggregate test-run totals. The current extractor also selects **5** additional numeric values from those historical M1 sections, for **34** historical-log values total. Evidence includes [golden PRNG vectors](../../crates/sim-core/tests/golden_prng_tests.rs), [determinism oracles](../../crates/sim-model/tests/determinism_oracle_tests.rs), [M0 graduation gate](../../crates/sim-model/tests/m0_determinism_gate_tests.rs), [snapshot tests](../../crates/sim-model/tests/phase11_snapshot_tests.rs), and the [M1 manifest](../../contracts/m1_contract.toml).

## Findings

- The tidy ledger uses `sources.toml` for provenance; old-ledger matching is informational only; see the ledger comparison tables above.
- The M1 aggregate run records are historical logs and are excluded from regeneration gap totals.
- M2 design-analysis reports without measurement outputs are marked analysis-only and excluded from regeneration gap totals.
- The largest gaps are grouped directly from the current status values in the tidy ledger; see Top evidence gaps.

## Limits

- A `reproducible-now` status means a source and data mapping is present; this inventory did not run the harness.
- Values excluded as input/configuration or outside the selected claim contexts are not assigned new provenance.
- This report compares source evidence only and does not remeasure timings or run simulations.
